select count(*) clueTotal, count(if(status = 1, 1,null)) clueWaitAllot , count(if(status = 2, 2,null)) clueWaitFollow, count(if(status = 3, 3,null)) clueFollowing, count(if(status = 4, 4,null)) clueFalse, count(if(status = 5, 5,null)) clueConvertBusiness
from clue;

select clue.*, ctr.*, user.name as assignName, ctr.id ctr_id, ctr.user_id ctr_user_id, ctr.subject ctr_subject, ctr.level ctr_level, ctr.next_time ctr_next_time, ctr.create_time ctr_create_time from clue left join clue_track_record ctr on ctr.clue_id = clue.id left join user on ctr.user_id = user.id where clue.id = #{id}
